name: Stepper {OS}
tagline: The dependency-aware step graph and its deterministic verification gate.

commands.name: omega-stepper init
commands.does: Scaffold the manifest, the spec tree and a first step

commands.name: omega-stepper validate
commands.does: Schema, uniqueness, reference resolution, DAG acyclicity

commands.name: omega-stepper resume
commands.does: Reconcile interrupted attempts back to FAILED

commands.name: omega-stepper status
commands.does: Raw and weighted progress with per-status counts

commands.name: omega-stepper plan
commands.does: Ranked READY candidates plus the safe execution wave

commands.name: omega-stepper show <id>
commands.does: Full spec and runtime state of one step

commands.name: omega-stepper agent-brief <id>
commands.does: Emit the self-contained brief a coding agent executes

commands.name: omega-stepper start <id>
commands.does: Claim a READY step and open an attempt

commands.name: omega-stepper verify <id>
commands.does: Run the deterministic checks without changing state

commands.name: omega-stepper done <id>
commands.does: Verify then close, DONE only on a full pass

commands.name: omega-stepper block <id>
commands.does: Block a step on an external decision or dependency

commands.name: omega-stepper unblock <id>
commands.does: Lift a block and return the step to PENDING

commands.name: omega-stepper review <id> <role>
commands.does: Record a review verdict for a role gate

commands.name: omega-stepper report
commands.does: Markdown status report, weighted and raw

commands.name: omega-stepper events
commands.does: Tail of the append-only event log

commands.name: omega-stepper release-check
commands.does: Plan completion at the target priority

commands.name: /stepper-os
commands.does: Open the execution OS and drive the loop

requires_human_approval_for: freezing the graph as BUILD READY
changing the target priority for the release gate
raising max_fix_attempts after a ceiling escalation
overriding a review gate, which an agent never does alone
accepting a step whose definition of done is a human review rather than a deterministic check
unblocking a step that was blocked on an upstream decision
